message: 流星に願いを
Even though we've been told to rest since it's a day off, I just can't seem to settle down.
I mean, sure, I don't need Ria-senpai to tell me that if we collapse on the big day, we'll cause a massive amount of trouble for everyone around us, but……

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look who showed up--it's the mysterious transfer student.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe Azel couldn't contain her excitement thinking about KiraFes either, and ended up coming to the academy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No way in hell.」

name: Synn
message: 「……What's she doing?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's holding somethin' in her hand.」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet it's a map of the KiraFes booth locations!」

name: Paqy
message: 「……Doesn't add up to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think? Then she's probably walking around looking at a campus map, trying to memorize the facilities and paths.」
Azel stops in her tracks and peers at whatever she's holding in her hand.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if something's wrong?」
And then, she stares intently at the ground.

name: Paqy
message: 「She stopped again.」
Azel walks a little, stops, and then starts walking once more.

name: Synn
message: 「She must be walking around picturing how the actual KiraFes will go. You know, image training.」
Suddenly, Azel raises her head.
She stares intently at something.

name: Synn
message: 「What's she looking at?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sometimes people can see things that ain't there.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「This academy's got a long history, y'know. There's gotta be one or two--nah, a hundred or two hundred occult mysteries around here.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way……」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're swarming all over this area too. Vengeful spirits! I can feel it! Right where that girl's looking, there's a guy covered in blood!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right?! Our familiar academy scenery suddenly turns into the setting of a horror movie?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't worry, I can't see anything at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Are you kidding me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I may be a great sage, but that stuff's outside my area of expertise.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't scare me like that.」
Azel started walking again.
Still, I wonder what she was looking at.
I stood in the spot where Azel had stopped and turned my eyes in the direction she had been looking.
A beautiful shimmer caught my eye.
It was a spiderweb sparkling in the sunlight.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ho. Fancy her having her eye caught by something like that.」
The tightly woven spiral web didn't have a single flaw. It shone just like a brooch made of glass and diamonds.

name: Paqy
message: 「Think it might rain tomorrow or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「...A spiderweb after the rain would probably be pretty too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, well. If you ask her, she'd say that kind of thing is pointless.」
I wonder if that's true.

name: Synn
message: 「There's no doubt about it, she was looking at this.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Maybe it's a biologically rare spider? She's a spider fanatic, you know. Could it be... Spider-Woman?」
I tried imagining Azel shooting webs from her fingertips.

name: Synn
message: 「...No, there's no way.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President spotted!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're a bad person, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?! Why am I the bad guy?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't even need to say it--I already know. You couldn't hold back your boiling youthful blood either, so you stayed behind at the academy to do Student Council activities, didn't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, Ria-senpai...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senior's words cannot suppress this passion. After all, they say youth is an explosion.」
I feel bad for Ria-senpai, though. I don't think I can just go home like this either.

name: Synn
message: 「You feel the same way, don't you, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? No, I don't? I'm just about to get dragged into the President's scheme and forced to do Student Council activities.」

name: Synn
message: 「You just said 'the President too,' didn't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Um, I think you're just hearing things. After all, they say humans tend to only want to hear what's convenient for them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you can go home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying? Trying to get a head start on me is forbidden!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Doing something naughty really gets my heart pounding~」

name: Synn
message: 「Shh. Keep it down.」
Sounds echo easily in the hallway.

name: Lolotte
message: 「There doesn't seem to be anyone around all the way up to the Student Council room.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now's our chance.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right. If we're going, now's the time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... wait.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President, you came for Student Council activities too!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, I didn't! I would never do something so audacious as going against Onee-sama's word to do Student Council work!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why are you here, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That's... obviously to keep watch in case delinquents like you two showed up!」

name: Synn
message: 「But didn't you just say, 'If we're going, now's the time'?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I never said anything of the sort! You're just hearing things, Sakura-kun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, that line. I heard it too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Me too.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're hearing things! I said you're hearing things!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Look straight into my round little eyes and at my adorable form, and tell me I'm just hearing things? Come on, try it」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You play dirty... Saying things like that while looking just like Blackuma!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I win」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone is a fellow degenerate, aren't we」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't want to be fellows like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah. Miss Senpai!」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan!」
An unnatural silence.

name: Ria
message: 「...Er, ahem」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now. Everyone has to listen to what your senpai tells you, okay」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm, so you see」

name: Ria
message: 「If you push yourselves too hard and collapse on the big day, it'll cause trouble for everyone. So you have to make sure you rest properly on your days off, okay」

name: Ria
message: 「So, um... do you understand?」

name: Synn
message: 「I understand」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um. I do understand, however...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The wild instincts known as the hot blood of youth drove out our reason」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm sorry, Big Sister」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, none of you can be helped」
It went without saying that Ria-senpai herself was included among those who couldn't be helped.
In the end. Nanaka, who came by to deliver soba thinking everyone must be getting hungry soon, joined in too.
Even Sally-chan came over to play.
Ultimately, we spent all the way until sunset preparing for Kirafes.
Though Sally-chan was just playing around the whole time…….

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. It's gotten completely dark!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku…… Impressive as always, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Saying you forgot something so you could turn back alone and set up a magic circle to take over the academy」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have that kind of power」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, none of the past Demon Lords had that kind of power either, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「As the Demon Lord, all you gotta do is sit back and look imposing. You're the Demon Lord, after all. Leave petty tricks like magic circles to your subordinates」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't even have any subordinates」

name: Paqy
message: 「I feel like there used to be guys who were good at that stuff…… Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, whatever, you've got yours truly, the Great Sage, right here」

name: Synn
message: 「So it's just one person……. But if that's the case, what is a Demon Lord supposed to do?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just fool around with women or whatever. You're the Demon Lord, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「You really are totally irresponsible…… Ah」
A rain of meteors streams silently across the sky.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe because there aren't many lights here compared to downtown…… it's amazing」
Maybe that was why.
Maybe the reason I went to the plaza beneath Finis Tower instead of heading home was because the meteors were so beautiful.
And then.
Azel was there.
She was looking up at the falling meteors.
Her profile, illuminated by the pale blue light, was beautiful.

name: Synn
message: 「Good evening」
This is my chance! I've got to say something.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you know why this town is called Ryuusei Town?」
Azel gave a small shake of her head.

name: Synn
message: 「You can see way more shooting stars in this town than anywhere else--it's been like that since way back.」

name: Azel
message: 「...How simplistic.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just how it is.」

name: Azel
message: 「What about you」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you think?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've been seeing them since I was born, so... I don't really find them mysterious or anything... They're pretty, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you think, Azel? Usually, everyone who comes to this town from outside gets surprised when they look up at the night sky.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is merely a physical phenomenon. Nothing worth being surprised over.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Maybe you're right.」
The shooting stars pouring down from the sky above Finis Tower fall one after another, only to disintegrate far short of hitting the ground or buildings, vanishing without a trace.
Endlessly, endlessly, all night long.

name: Azel
message: 「However...」

name: Azel
message: 「The person who took that photo collection would likely capture this sight as something beautiful.」
I see. He really does think it's beautiful after all.
Azel is standoffish, skips class all the time, and it's hard to tell what he's thinking, though.
Even so, he feels the same way we do.
Though I guess that's only natural.
With this many, it feels like any wish could come true.
I want Azel to open his heart to everyone.
I want KiraFes to go well.
Still, the shooting stars vanish right away. They disappear before you can finish saying your wish.

name: Synn
message: 「People have always said that if you make a wish before a shooting star disappears, it'll come true, but... do you have a similar saying in your country, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...What is that」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you don't have that in your country.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, the time before a shooting star disappears is way too short, so it ends before you can even say anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even a short wish like, 'I want KiraFes to go well'... you don't make it in time.」
As for my other wish, I can't quite say it out loud.

name: Azel
message: 「There is no such option as wishing」
Before I knew it, Azel had started walking.

name: Azel
message: 「We merely receive what the gods bestow upon us」
His small back melts into the night.

name: Azel
message: 「Wishes... are unnecessary」
I was left behind in the darkness.
